_comment: Example configuration. Copy to site-gates.config.json and replace with your own.
The word lists here are illustrative: internal codenames, placeholder text and
profanity are the three things most commonly caught leaving a build. Your real
list belongs in your own repository, not in a published example.

vocabulary._hard: No innocent use. Any occurrence fails, in a file name or a file body.
vocabulary._soft: Ordinary words that also appear innocently. Regex. Fail only outside `allow`.
_allow: Each entry is why a soft hit is not a violation. Use specific strings, never bare
terms: allowing `temp` wholesale would make the sweep decorative.

contrast._comment: WCAG 2.1: 4.5 for normal text, 3 for large (>=24px, or >=18.66px bold).

_comment: A hand-maintained list against the data it mirrors. `source` is the real data;
`mirror` is the copy that goes stale. Each pattern needs one capture group.

pairs.name: page titles known to the nav
